Both sides of every mock journal balance
Seeded shop does not read another shop product
Revoked shop membership never falls back to another active shop membership
Duplicate idempotency key is not duplicated
Same key with different payload is rejected
Stale inventory adjustment cannot mutate stock
Read model reflects source amounts not current page
Unknown command retains the same result on idempotent retry

checks.name: Registers every canonical HTTP operation and reports the custom SSE endpoint
Loads the service worker only in demo mode and guards production from mock activation
Covers the canonical route, feature, shop, and role catalogs
Returns schema-valid, paginated data and rejects stale cursors
Pages through a deterministic large dataset without dropping or duplicating rows
Scopes reads to the requested shop and role permissions
Maps request validation, CSRF, and missing If-Match to contract errors
Creates a product with schema-complete variants through HTTP
Preserves idempotency and exposes stale and unknown mutation outcomes over HTTP
Resets records, role, faults, idempotency keys, sequence, and fixed clock deterministically
Returns observable transient and empty states without fabricating records
Aborted delayed reads do not leak into the next request
Streams only the authorized shop and emits events matching the canonical v2 schema
